jobs.details: Company Description Best Home Textile transforms deep textile expertise into versatile fabric solutions for global partners. The company specializes in brushed fabrics for bedding and other applications, combining quality, comfort, and flexibility to meet evolving industry needs. With a strong commitment to excellence and attention to detail, Best Home Textile focuses on delivering fabrics that inspire new possibilities and support long-term partnerships. Quality is woven into every aspect of the business, creating lasting value for customers and stakeholders. Role Description The Chinese Translator at Best Home Textile will provide accurate translation and interpretation between Chinese and English (and/or Arabic) for day-to-day business operations. This includes translating technical and commercial documents, assisting in communication with Chinese-speaking partners and suppliers, and supporting meetings, factory visits, and production-related discussions. The role also involves reviewing and clarifying specifications, coordinating with internal teams to ensure mutual understanding, and maintaining consistent terminology and style across written materials. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Suez, requiring regular presence at the facility in Ain Sokhna, Egypt. Qualifications • Strong language proficiency in Chinese and English (and preferably Arabic), with the ability to translate and interpret accurately in both directions. • Experience translating business, technical, or textile-related documents, with attention to industry terminology and detail. • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to support cross-cultural collaboration with internal teams and external partners. • Organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple translation tasks
